newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker against the dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker at 42.5490/5500 to the dollar in interbank trading against the previous close of 42.5480/5500, dealers said.

They said the taka remained weaker on higher demand for dollars as banks, anticipating a devaluation of the local unit, were reluctant to sell the U.S. currency. Many banks had to buy dollars from the central bank after the rates hit the official band of 42.35/55.
Interbank call money rates ended unchanged at 4.0 percent to 4.75 percent, dealers said.
